title: Roar of the Electric Pitch
idea: When a legendary soccer showdown hits a bustling tropical metropolis, The Boss tasks the crew with scouting the beloved home team in fierce orange and red. Prof analyzes endless tactical formations, Slim is confident charisma guarantees victory, and Tank scrutinizes the pitch's slick turf. Cocky Lucky bets on raw momentum, but a sudden tropical storm knocks out stadium power just before the decisive half. Navigating wild stadium chaos from the catwalks, the robots scramble to see whether heart or cold calculation will carry match day.
visual: A colossal open-air stadium glowing beneath dramatic monsoon clouds, illuminated by golden floodlights and waving seas of fiery orange banners. The lush green pitch sparkles under the rain as miniature robots peer down from a towering steel gantry.
